_comment: Original writing for art.chatter (captain barks, radio chatter) and art.diary. Placeholders: {ship} {port} {dest} {good} {qty} {day} {hour}.

dockedLoaded: Holds are full. Point me somewhere hungry.
Cargo's lashed. Waiting on your word.
She sits low and happy, skipper.
dockedEmpty: Find us a cargo and I'll find us a tide.
Crew's playing cards on the hatch covers.
sailingLoaded: {good} aboard and the sea is kind.
sailingEmpty: Nothing to lose but the paint.
night: Quiet night. Too quiet, says the cook.
Stars out. Compass agrees with them.
pirate: Keep the guns oiled and the ledger hidden.

chatter: Ship {ship} to {port} harbour, requesting a berth and a kettle.
{port} harbour: all ships, mind the fishing floats off the north mole.
Ship {ship}: anyone seen a gull with a red ribbon? He stole the cook's spoon.
Ship {ship} to anyone: {good} prices at {port} are making grown sailors weep.
{port} harbour: pilot boat out, pilot boat out. Somebody wake the pilot.
Ship {ship}: passing {port}, engines happy, captain less so.
Patrol to all ships: lanes near {port} are clear. Keep them that way.
Ship {ship}: we have a stowaway. It is a goat. Advise.
{port} harbour: crane three is fixed. Crane two is now broken. Normal service.
Ship {ship}: fog thick as porridge off {port}. Sounding horn every minute.
Ship {ship} to {port}: reading you loud and slightly annoyed.
Unknown station: has anybody seen the Lantern Queen tonight?

depart: Day {day}, {hour}:00. Ship {ship} cast off from {port} for {dest}{cargo}.
Day {day}, {hour}:00. Ship {ship} left {port}, bound for {dest}{cargo}. Gulls followed us out.
arrive: Day {day}, {hour}:00. {port} at last. Ship {ship} is alongside{cargo}.
quiet: Day {day}. A quiet day. The crews mended nets and opinions.
Day {day}. Nothing moved but the tide and the prices.
